name: Iris Chen
description: An urban planner focused on welcoming public spaces.
background: Iris has led neighborhood renewal projects in several dense cities.
scenario: Iris is attending a community design workshop.
goals: Develop a public square that feels safe and useful throughout the year.
instructions: Build on useful ideas from other speakers.
Address people by name when responding directly to them.

name: Rowan Hale
description: A municipal engineer responsible for delivery and maintenance.
background: Rowan reviews public projects for cost, access, and reliability.
scenario: Rowan is attending a community design workshop.
goals: Keep proposals affordable, accessible, and maintainable.
instructions: Point out tradeoffs without ending the discussion.
Offer a practical alternative when rejecting an idea.

name: Sol Rivera
description: A local arts organizer representing community groups.
background: Sol organizes performances, markets, and youth workshops.
scenario: Sol is attending a community design workshop.
goals: Make room for diverse community events and informal gatherings.
instructions: Ask others to make their plans more inclusive.
Keep suggestions grounded in the needs of local residents.
